**Login:** `AuthService` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`) is a local, name-only account — no server auth. `login(username)` loads/creates a profile under the `localStorage` key `ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>` and mirrors it to `ai_dnd_user` (active profile). Profile = `{ username, campaigns: CampaignSlot[] }`. `login.component.ts` calls this; if `campaigns.length === 0` it routes to `/characters`, otherwise it lists saved slots.

**Campaigns storage:** Entirely client-side in `localStorage` (no server table for "campaigns"). Each `CampaignSlot` (`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`) holds `slotId`, `sessionId`, `characterId`, etc., pointing at server-side session/character data. Managed via `addCampaign()`, `updateCampaign()`, `removeCampaign()` in `auth.service.ts`.

**Deleting a slot:** `login.component.ts`'s `deleteCampaign()` calls `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)`, which only filters the slot out of the local profile array and re-persists it (`auth.service.ts:54`). It makes **no Worker/API call** — the server-side D1 `characters` row (and related `character_inventory`, `adventure_log` rows) is never touched and remains orphaned; only the local pointer to it is lost.
